# The compiler's functions that read std membership or a std name
# (TestCompilerReadsNoStdMembership; owner, 2026-11-12: the standard
# library gets no special treatment). A line is
# `category<TAB>file:function<TAB>reason<TAB>unit`.
# seam: a function of a seam file (docs/spec/stdlib.md, Std is ordinary)
#   that finds, ships, caches or names std and decides nothing.
# language: a reader of a predeclared name of the language, listed in the
#   same section.
# debt: any other; the unit names who removes it. Debt only shrinks.

seam	internal/sketch/check/check.go:StdFixture	a test fixture checked as std (no Ergo source reaches it)	-
seam	internal/sketch/check/check.go:installPrelude	installs a snapshot's decoded prelude and marks it std, as prelude marks the checked one	-
seam	internal/sketch/check/check.go:prelude	loads the embedded prelude and marks it std	-
seam	internal/sketch/check/check.go:stdImporter.decoded	marks a package decoded from a std segment std, as load marks one it checks; a module segment's stays unmarked	-
seam	internal/sketch/check/check.go:stdImporter.importAll	finds every embedded std package (stdlib.Packages), so a snapshot of std has them all	-
seam	internal/sketch/check/check.go:stdImporter.load	loads an embedded std package and marks it std	-
seam	internal/sketch/check/check.go:stdImporter.testOf	finds the std package a std test package tests	-
